newsitem.title: USA: Police, seeking Versace killer, probe new murder.
newsitem.headline: Police, seeking Versace killer, probe new murder.

text.p: Police probing the murder of a Miami doctor on Thursday said no link had yet been established with the killing of fashion designer Gianni Versace.
A search through woods near the Miami Springs home of the new murder victim was called off after neither clues nor suspects were found, police spokesman Juan Castillo said.
Police named the doctor as Silvio Alfonso. He was found dead in his bedroon on Thursday morning, prompting speculation that the suspected killer of Versace had struck again.
Police and FBI agents pored over the crime scene but Castillo said: "At this time there is no link. But we haven't ruled out anything."
Alfonso's wallet was found a few blocks from his house. Castillo said he was not shot, as earlier reports said, but cause of death had not been established.
Local TV quoted neighbours as saying Alfonso was homosexual but others said had a wife and childen in Cuba. Police would not comment on his sexual orientation.
The only suspect in the Versace murder, Andrew Cunanan, is wanted by the FBI in connection with four other murders.
